title: Safe Subgame Resolving in Multiplayer Games
abstract: arXiv:2611.25981v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Poker and other games with hidden information are too large to solve in one pass. Strong systems compute a complete blueprint strategy offline and refine it in real time inside the reached subgame. In 2p0s games, a safety theorem guarantees that subgame resolving never increases how much an adversary can gain by exploiting the resolved strategy relative to the blueprint strategy. With three or more players acting independently, no such guarantee exists yet, and heuristic resolving can increase the profile's best-response gap. We prove the first conditional safety theorem for uncorrelated multiplayer subgame resolving, a post-hoc certificate for any delivered update. The best-response gap of the resolved profile exceeds that of the blueprint by at most four terms. translated_title: 多人游戏中的安全子博弈求解
translated_abstract: 扑克及其他具有隐藏信息的博弈规模庞大，无法一次性完整求解。强大的系统会先离线计算完整的蓝图策略，再在实际到达的子博弈中对其进行实时细化。在双人零和博弈中，安全定理保证子博弈求解绝不会增加对手通过利用已求解策略相对于蓝图策略所能获得的收益。然而，当三个或更多玩家独立行动时，目前尚不存在这样的保证，启发式求解可能会增大策略组合的最佳响应差距。我们证明了首个针对非相关多人子博弈求解的条件性安全定理，这是一个适用于任何已交付策略更新的事后证明证书。已求解策略组合的最佳响应差距相对蓝图最多超出四项：其中两项与求解器相关，分别是蓝图承诺但未能实现的子博弈价值（A_i^S）以及求解器的子博弈求解误差（ε_i）；另外两项是……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文证明了首个针对非相关多人博弈子博弈求解的条件性安全定理，表明已求解策略的最佳响应差距相对蓝图最多增加四项（其中两项源于求解器的未实现承诺子博弈价值与求解误差），从而为多人博弈中的实时策略细化提供了事后安全证明证书。
en_tdlr: This paper proves the first conditional safety theorem for uncorrelated multiplayer subgame resolving, showing that the resolved profile's best-response gap exceeds the blueprint's by at most four terms, and thereby provides a post-hoc safety certificate for real-time strategy refinement in multiplayer games.
